trigger.detail: Phase 1 first run. Owner instruction 'proceed'. Target: the three DB6 role lenses missing against a sub-sector whose DB9 role set is already complete.

schema.detail: All 13 DB6 fields checked against contracts/sector-databases.json; only the 11 whose writer_skill is S02 were written. Platform Overlays and Narrative Positions left untouched (S10).

context_resolution.detail: Resolved through the graph: Sub-Sector 'Accommodation (Hotels)' (Status=Target) -> Parent Sector 'Hospitality' -> plugin hospitality. No name string-matching, no Hospitality default.

decision_purpose.detail: Each lens has a named downstream consumer: Content (04) by rollup, S08 outreach angle.

evidence_sufficient.detail: Every layer traces to a cited source recorded in the page body. No layer written from unsourced prior knowledge.

confidence_matches_evidence.detail: Medium on all three. Trade-press and industry-body material only; no T1/T2 primary confirmation of language patterns, so High was not available.

tier_and_freshness.detail: Tiers recorded per source in each page body. Operator row flagged: 3 of 4 sources are T4 vendor content - usable for language, barred from confirming market fact per contract 4.4.

no_fabrication.detail: Zero named individuals. Access Paths carry venues and communities only. The Enabler incentive layer is explicitly labelled inferred rather than stated.

relation_targets_exist.detail: Sub-Sector relation verified live before write; resolves on read-back.

cross_database_coherence.detail: Role coherence holds: each new DB6 Role Lens has its DB9 Role counterpart for the same sub-sector. Coverage now 4/4 lenses in both DB6 and DB9.

payload.decision_reason: Three DB6 rows created (Operator, Amplifier, Enabler). DB9 and DB10 were NO_OP: DB9 already held all four canonical role lenses and DB10 its four buyer titles for this sub-sector, both verified before research began. Writing either would have duplicated existing rows.

post_write_verification.method: Read back the Enabler row in full (properties + page body) and confirmed the Sub-Sector relation resolves. The create response echoed all properties for all three rows.

trigger.detail: Mandatory co-run with S02 on one shared research_run_id.

schema.detail: All 15 DB3 fields checked; only the 12 whose writer_skill is S01 were written. Geography deliberately left empty - neither finding is place-bound.

context_resolution.detail: Same resolved context as the S02 co-run.

decision_purpose.detail: Both findings carry a Recommended Action naming a department and a concrete change. Neither would have been written without one.

evidence_sufficient.detail: Both cite named publishers with URLs. Neither rests on unsourced prior knowledge.

confidence_matches_evidence.detail: Medium on both. The vendor/partner finding rests on ONE T3 opinion piece plus indirect T2 corroboration; the convergence finding is T2 for the association's own agenda but NOT evidence of market-wide adoption. Both limits are written into the page bodies.

tier_and_freshness.detail: Freshness=Fresh, verified today. Tier caveats recorded per finding; both barred from driving a client-facing execution without T1/T2 confirmation.

no_fabrication.detail: No invented figure, date, price or contact. Where a claim is inferred rather than sourced it is labelled as inferred.

relation_targets_exist.detail: Sub-Sector relation verified live before write.

cross_database_coherence.detail: Both findings corroborate the DB6 language maps written in the same run; the vendor/partner finding and the DB6 Enabler row carry the same flagged weakness, recorded identically in both places.

payload.decision_reason: Two findings created. Duplicate detection ran first against all four existing DB3 rows for this sub-sector (OTA commission leak, direct-booking share, tool-stack fragmentation, GM+RM buyer dyad); neither new finding overlaps. No third finding was written - the run produced no further claim that could name an action, and padding DB3 to look productive is a contract breach.

post_write_verification.method: Create response echoed all properties for both rows, including Routed To resolving against the live 21-value canonical option set fetched at write time.
